mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Check that a new service binding can be created with the given name and service definition.

description: [read-only] Validates a new service binding named by service_binding_name for the service definition named by service_definition_name, before it is created. Required: service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*. Optional: service_binding_version, package_name, description. Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

service_definition_name.description: Service definition name to pair with binding.

name: HandlerServiceBindingValidate
